acquisition method: coupled to the Orbitrap Exploris 240 system, in DDA mode.
alkylation reagent: followed by in-gel alkylation using iodoacetamide (50 mM) in ammonium bicarbonate (25 mM).
alkylation concentration: followed by in-gel alkylation using iodoacetamide (50 mM) in ammonium bicarbonate (25 mM).
cleavage agent: followed by in-gel tryptic digestion with 1.5 to 2 μg trypsin (Pierce Trypsin Protease MS grade Cat no. 90059, Thermo Fisher) in 300 μl ammonium bicarbonate (25 mM) at 37 °C for 16 h.
enrichment method: Immunoprecipitations (IPs) were carried out using anti-methyllysine antibodies (Invitrogen, Cat. no: PA5-77770).
instrument: coupled to the Q Exactive Plus Orbitrap system
labeling: Analysis was performed using the Proteome Discoverer 2.4 software (label-free quantification)
reduction reagent: subjected to in-gel reduction using DTT (10 mM) in ammonium bicarbonate (25 mM)
reduction concentration: subjected to in-gel reduction using DTT (10 mM) in ammonium bicarbonate (25 mM)
